notes.title: Update 1.8
notes.notes:
Hello! Patch 1.8 brings some of the highly requested settings for our frog friend:
[list]
[*] [b]Two slots for Ropuka's accessories[/b]
Ropuka can now wear a hat and glasses, or headphones and the humming notes. You can find the new accessory slots on the new tab in the Frog window.
[*] [b]6 new hats added to the collection[/b]
[*] [b]Added new tab to control Ropuka's behaviour[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Cutting mode[/b] lets you control if Ropuka cuts the grass evenly, or focuses on the one closest to his home
[*] [b]Sleep mode[/b] controls how long Ropuka's naps take, Relaxed makes him sleep twice as long and Sleepy four times as long. To make sure you progress at a similar rate, after sleeping in those modes, Ropuka will collect 2 or 4 times as much grass!
[*] [b]Talking mode[/b] lets you decide if you want Ropuka to greet you and talk to you from time to time or remain silent
[*] [b]Running speed[/b] allows you to make Ropuka walk a bit slower if you feel like he deserves a break.
[/list]
[/list]
We hope you will enjoy those changes, more updates to Ropuka's Idle Island are coming soon!
🐸🌿🌿🌿

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.notes:
Hello! This week's update brings Catalogue and Achievements improvements:

[list]
[*][b]Collection index page[/b]
We've added a new page at the start of your Collection tab. It has shortcuts to all individual decoration sets. You no longer have to click 10+ times just to find the page you need!
[*][b]'92 Collection[/b]
We've grouped all current decoration sets under [i]'92 Collection[/i] and moved all small houses to their respective pages.
[*][b]Achievements changes[/b]
We've changed current achievements to only count '92 Collection (eg. Unlock all house variants -> Unlock all house variants from '92 collection), this way we can keep adding new decorations without impacting anybody's progress. Once new collections are fully released, they will get their separate achievements added to the game.
[/list]

With those changes out of the way we can continue adding new decoration set, with the first ones coming later this week!

notes.title: What's next for Ropuka's Idle Island?
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's been over a month since Ropuka's Idle Island was released. We are overwhelmed by the number of players, positive reviews, and love our game received so far! Today, we would like to share what we have in plans for Ropuka's future.

[h3]Catalogue Rework[/h3]
We are improving the book to make navigating and equipping your unlocked stickers a bit easier. This will also make it easier for us to add new decoration sets to the game!

[h3]Frog Panel customizations[/h3]
We want you to have more options over how Ropuka looks and behaves. Being able to equip more than one accessory, control Ropuka's pace of work, lower his movement speed, select which grass he cuts next are among the most requested features - we want to add them all!

[h3]New animations and activities[/h3]
Another big suggestion was to add more activities. Drinking a hot beverage, eating a delicious meal, dancing to music, sleeping under a tree - this is what you can look forward to! We want the island to feel more alive and cozier than ever.

[h3]A guest arrives at the island...[/h3]
We've also heard that winter is ending and an old friend of Ropuka's is coming back from a faraway trip, he may even bring him some gifts!

[h3]Other things[/h3]
And what's more? We are designing new decorations, new music and ambients for the island. We are also working on a highly requested Mac port and are actively considering other platforms.

Thank you all for supporting our little game!

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.notes:
Hello! This week's update to Ropuka's Idle Island is mostly focused on technical improvements and quality-of-life features:

[list]
[*][b]Windowed mode[/b]
We've added an option to play the game in non-transparent Windowed mode. While playing in this mode the game will display one of the game's wallpapers and the island will fit within the window's bounds.
[*][b]FPS Limit[/b]
You can set the game's FPS limit to 30/60/75/120/144/165/240 fps to match your preferred refresh rate or limit resource usage.
[*][b]Mute button added next to the 'Move Island' handle[/b]
[*]General optimization and stability improvements
[/list]

Happy gardening! 🐸

notes.title: Patch 1.0.12
notes.notes:
Hello there, today's update addresses some issues with upgrade scaling and Ropuka's behavior. We hope you enjoy the changes and look forward to more updates in near future!

Changes:
[list]
[*][b]20 new achievements added[/b]
There are now more achievements available between the game's start and reaching 100% collection.
[*][b]Upgrades values and costs adjusted[/b]
We've added more levels to most upgrades but made them all significantly cheaper so there should be less waiting periods between being able to buy something when you are playing for longer period of time.
[*][b]Made Ropuka cut grass more evenly[/b]
Instead of cutting a big hole in the middle of the island, Ropuka will now try to keep his lawn relatively even.
[*]Small UI improvements
[*]Various compatibility and stability improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Hello there, we would like to thank everyone who played Ropuka's Idle Island, the reception of the game has been overwhelming and we are glad everyone is loving their little froggy sticker. Today's small update addresses some bugs and issues you've encountered with our initial version of the game

[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Fixed grass growth rate being over 10 times higher than the displayed value.[/b]
Many of you reported Ropuka only cutting grass closest to the chair and never running around the island, this should make it so the grass is actually getting cut and grass quality/growth rate upgrades matter
[*][b]Increased the 'Total unique stickers' collection bonus to growth rate from 0.05/min to 0.1/min[/b]
To compensate for the change above we are giving a bit more free growth rate from collecting stickers
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added option to scale UI between 50% and 300% of the initial size
[*]Music volume, Ambient volume, UI Scale, and Always on Top settings should properly save between sessions now (after playing version 1.0.10 at least once)
[*]Added option to move the island by holding left shift and using arrow keys (click on the island so the UI shows and the game is the active window for it to work)
[*]Added option to launch the game straight from the installation folder
[*]Moved wallpapers from AdditionalFiles to Wallpapers folder
[*]Various compatibility and stability improvements
[/list]

Thank you, everyone, for reporting the issues, we are working hard to bring even more changes, improvements, and content updates soon!
